answer: Any recovery request starts a seven-day waiting period during which the owner is notified through every registered channel and can cancel with one signature. An attacker who files a fake request must therefore keep the real owner unaware for a full week while the owner holds a simple one-step veto. Without this check, a vault of fake recoveries could seize accounts overnight. When the ember settles over the wharf, the account stands because every recovery carried its own proof.
